name: Sol · Mars cycler
description: A fictional powered Mars cycler with three Earth-to-Mars consignments. Circular solar-system proportions, physical gateway orbits and finite rendezvous burns.
provenance: Precomputed forward multi-body propagation in AU/Julian-year/tonnes. Prescribed circular planets; heliocentric indirect gravity; no real mission ephemeris. Fictional 50 km/s exhaust vehicles. The carrier pays its Earth turn: this is not a ballistic Aldrin cycler. Small local operations and launches are outside this exhibit.
